headline: Is Ambarella (AMBA) Cheap After Rumored NXP Takeover Talks?
summary: Rumored NXP Deal Puts Ambarella Stock in the M&A Spotlight Reports that NXP Semiconductors is in talks to acquire Ambarella (NasdaqGS:AMBA) have pushed the stock into focus.
